description: Use this when picking test doubles for a new SDK client — choosing between in-memory wire-protocol fakes (miniredis, embedded NATS), gomock against a caller-owned narrow interface, or testcontainers for integration. Covers compile-time interface assertions and the interface-size ceiling rule.
